territorial_scope.description: Applies to qualifying data center facilities located in Minnesota.

evidence.quote: means a facility in Minnesota:

summary.short: Exempts from Minnesota sales and use tax purchases of enterprise IT equipment and computer software by qualified data centers, qualified refurbished data centers and qualified large-scale data centers that meet square-footage and investment thresholds. Refunds follow certification by the Commissioner of Employment and Economic Development.
summary.long: Subdivision 42 of Minnesota Statutes section 297A.68 exempts from the taxes of Chapter 297A purchases of enterprise information technology equipment and computer software for use in a qualified data center, a qualified refurbished data center or a qualified large-scale data center (para. a). A qualified data center is a Minnesota facility of at least 25,000 square feet with total construction or refurbishment, equipment and software costs of at least $30,000,000 within a 48-month period, and with specified power, fire suppression and security features (para. b). A qualified refurbished data center requires $50,000,000 within a 24-month period (para. c). A qualified large-scale data center requires at least 25,000 square feet connected by fiber and $250,000,000 collectively within a 60-month period beginning after June 30, 2025 (para. e). The exempt tax is collected and then refunded, and no refund issues until the Commissioner of Employment and Economic Development certifies the facility (paras. h, i). Exemption claims are limited to purchases within 35 years of the first qualifying purchase (para. f). Construction work on qualified large-scale data centers must pay prevailing wages and follow specified enforcement provisions (para. k). Those centers must certify a sustainable design or green building standard within three years after being placed in service, and the exemption must be repaid if the Commissioner of Commerce determines non-compliance (paras. l, m).

"qualified data center" means a facility in Minnesota:
"qualified refurbished data center" means an existing facility that qualifies as a data center under paragraph (b), clauses (2) and (3)
"qualified large-scale data center" means a facility in Minnesota:
"enterprise information technology equipment" means computers and equipment supporting computing, networking, or data storage, including servers and routers.
"substantially refurbished" means that at least 25,000 square feet have been rebuilt or modified, including:

"computer software" includes, but is not limited to, software utilized or loaded at a qualified data center, qualified refurbished data center, or qualified large-scale data center, including maintenance, licensing, and software customization.
"refurbish" does not include maintenance or equipment refreshment or replacement.
